lines.text: Asaph cries aloud to God in his day of trouble, and his soul refuses to be comforted.
At night Asaph remembers his song and asks if God's promise has failed and His anger has shut off His power.

wrong_details.wrong: His anger has shut off His power
wrong_details.true: His anger has shut off His compassion

lines.text: Asaph says the right hand of the Most High has changed, then decides to remember the works of the LORD.
Asaph says God's way is holy and that God redeemed the sons of Moab and Ammon with power.

wrong_details.wrong: the sons of Moab and Ammon
wrong_details.true: the sons of Jacob and Joseph

lines.text: The earth trembles at God's thunder, and He leads His people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
